metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Bergen County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: West Englewood & Historic Estate Area, Cedar Lane & Central District, Glenpointe & Teaneck Road Corridor, Phelps Park & Country Club Section
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 3.49%, with an equalization ratio of 67.5%.
Public education represents 59.2% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 29.8%.
Average residential assessment is $378,000, producing an average annual tax bill of $13,192.2.

neighborhoods.name: West Englewood & Historic Estate Area
neighborhoods.character: Stately stone and brick Tudors, center-hall colonials, expansive manicured grounds, and quiet residential parkways
neighborhoods.description: Prestigious residential district featuring majestic pre-war architecture, proximity to synagogues and private academies, and quiet residential parkways.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: High property tax bracket with school district levy absorbing 58.8% of certified property tax payments.

neighborhoods.name: Cedar Lane & Central District
neighborhoods.character: Walkable town center surrounding Cedar Lane shopping, multi-family homes, colonials, and townhouses
neighborhoods.description: The commercial and community pulse of Teaneck, featuring independent merchants, cinemas, kosher markets, and convenient bus transportation to NYC.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Commercial retail ratables provide a buffer for township municipal operational appropriations.

neighborhoods.name: Glenpointe & Teaneck Road Corridor
neighborhoods.character: Mixed suburban and corporate corridor near Glenpointe Marriott complex and Overpeck County Park
neighborhoods.description: Eastern residential district adjacent to the 800-acre Overpeck County Park, offering horse riding, kayak launches, and athletic tracks.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Major corporate ratables at Glenpointe Office Center provide essential non-residential tax ratable support.

neighborhoods.name: Phelps Park & Country Club Section
neighborhoods.character: Wooded residential setting bordering Hackensack River and historic Phelps estate lands, with mid-century colonials and split-levels
neighborhoods.description: Tranquil residential area surrounding Phelps Park and Fairleigh Dickinson University campus, characterized by deep lawns and park-like views.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Substantial untaxed university properties create ongoing PILOT contribution discussions.

equityAnalysis.summary: Teaneck Township maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Teaneck Township, homeowners pay an average of $13,192.2 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 10.44% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 67.5%, assessed values average ~67.5% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 59.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 29.8%, and Bergen County claims 11.0%.
